scope: Own trainable coherent optical neural simulator in Blender; fabrication optional
research_question: Can Blender-Lab construct and execute coherent optical neural networks from the actual Blender scene with quantitatively valid, reproducible results, useful error certificates and explicit rejection beyond its model?

priorities.name: Falsifiable contribution and novelty
priorities.achieved: Operational identity/completeness/field/readout gates; directed review concludes NOVELTY_NOT_ESTABLISHED
priorities.acceptance: Implemented joint certificate and nonvacuous frozen family; primary comparison and justified originality or explicit replication contribution
priorities.remaining: End-to-end evidence and pending literature extraction

priorities.name: Units, coherence, phases, parameters, detectors
priorities.acceptance: Versioned contract enforced at actual scene ingress; analytic controls and roundtrip; normalized power separated from calibrated watts
priorities.remaining: Full solver and training consumption; certified native error and physical regime remain separate
priorities.achieved: Explicit units, common phase/coherence, modal readout enforced; 50 CPU controls; actual Iris bpy admission and fixture save/reopen PASS

priorities.name: Frozen pilot and captured-scene traversal
priorities.acceptance: Valid external registration or explicit human GitHub exception, then execute unchanged archived protocol and independent categorical audit

priorities.name: Coherent propagation and error
priorities.acceptance: All relevant branches covered; adverse controls; capture/representation/geometry/phase/sum/readout budgets complete; invalid margins stay unknown

priorities.name: Own inference and training from geometry
priorities.acceptance: Forward and gradients originate from captured geometry; held-fixed readout; training-only preprocessing and updates; saved scene changes reproduce inference

priorities.name: Capacity, stability, physical fidelity
priorities.acceptance: State restricted function family; compare analytic and independent wave references over declared regime; physical-model error quantified or unknown

priorities.name: Generalization and equivalent baselines
priorities.acceptance: Prospectively fixed held-out evaluation, no test-fitted preprocessing, matched algebraic and scientific baselines; uncertainty and failures reported

priorities.name: Optimizations, NVIDIA, AMD, complete cost
priorities.acceptance: Equivalent outputs and precision, actual vendor execution receipts, complete preparation/transfer/compute/readout/training cost and resource/ablation evidence

priorities.name: Recovery, Blender interface, clean reproduction
priorities.acceptance: Install/edit/run/cancel/save/reopen/export; guarded failure recovery; clean-environment documented reproduction

priorities.name: External reproduction and scientific article
priorities.acceptance: Release evidence and reproducible article; independently executed external reproduction explicitly distinguished from local checks
